analysis.reasonEn: The wait-and-see stance has been maintained for the past 3 sessions. RSI has declined from overbought territory into the neutral zone, and the MACD histogram's improvement is slowing, showing potential for a negative crossover. The current price of $2,406.4 is below the SMA5 of $2,438.28, consolidating near the Bollinger Band middle line, indicating a lack of clear direction.

· 현재가($2,406.4) vs SMA5($2,438.28) 하회, SMA20($2,273.12) 상회: 단기 약세 전환, 중기 강세 유지.
· SMA100($1,898.93) 및 SMA200($2,027.05) 상회: 중장기 추세 강도 양호.
· 52주 위치(27.6%): 역사적 저점 대비 높은 수준, 고점 대비 상당한 눌림 구간.
[모멘텀 지표]
· RSI 77.7 → 63.0 (과매수 냉각): 과열 부담 완화, 중립 구간 진입.
· MACD 히스토그램 43.0765 → -3.0989 (개선 둔화): 상승 모멘텀 약화, 데드크로스 임박 가능성.
· 볼린저밴드 현재가 위치(중단 $2,273.12): 밴드폭 45.20%로 넓으나 현재가 중단 부근 횡보.
[지지·저항 구조]
· 스윙 지지선 ($2,387.61): 피벗 S1($1,990.79) 및 SMA200($2,027.05) 대비 높은 수준.
· 스윙 저항선 ($2,423.04): 5일 고가($2,534.01) 및 볼린저 상단($2,786.81) 대비 낮은 수준.
· 5일/20일 고가·저가 패턴 (횡보): 명확한 Higher Low 또는 Lower High 미확인.
[거래량·결론]
· 거래량 비율 1.13 (정상): 현재 움직임에 대한 신뢰도 보통 수준.
· 현 구간 진단 (축적구간): 방향성 부재, 지지선($2,387.61) 및 저항선($2,423.04) 사이 횡보 지속 시 관망 유지.
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($2,406.4) below SMA5 ($2,438.28), above SMA20 ($2,273.12): short-term bearish turn, mid-term bullish intact.
· Above SMA100 ($1,898.93) and SMA200 ($2,027.05): long-term trend strength remains robust.
· 52-week position (27.6%): high level relative to historical lows, significant pullback from highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI 77.7 → 63.0 (cooling from overbought): easing overheating pressure, entering neutral zone.
· MACD histogram 43.0765 → -3.0989 (slowing improvement): weakening bullish momentum, potential for dead cross.
· Bollinger Band current price position (middle line $2,273.12): band width is wide at 45.20%, but price is consolidating around the middle band.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($2,387.61): high level relative to Pivot S1 ($1,990.79) and SMA200 ($2,027.05).
· Swing resistance ($2,423.04): low level relative to 5-day high ($2,534.01) and Bollinger upper band ($2,786.81).
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (consolidation): no clear Higher Low or Lower High confirmed.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio 1.13 (normal): moderate confidence in current price action.
· Current phase diagnosis (accumulation): lack of directional conviction, maintain wait-and-see if consolidation between support ($2,387.61) and resistance ($2,423.04) continues.
